spec.source: zircote/swagger-php @OA annotations on Api/*.php handler methods and Model classes
spec.note: The document is a build artifact and is absent from a fresh clone; PHP is not installed here, so these 490 operations were read directly from the annotations that produce it. Run the command above for the full document including component schemas.

auth.scheme: PHP session cookie set by a form login

csrf.note: the token must be read from the login page in the same session; a POST without it is rejected.

users.note: the public demo publishes Admin / admin123

auth.note: No token flow exists. A CSRF-bearing form POST is the only way in, which is why this app logs in once through the UI and reuses the saved session.

notes: Tier A: every row is an @OA annotation on the handler that serves it, so the path, summary, operationId and tag are the app's own words rather than an inference. CI fails a PR whose annotations are wrong, which makes them unusually trustworthy.

490 operations across 141 tags. A request payload is recorded where the annotation declares a RequestBody; where it is absent the operation takes no body, or references a component schema that only the generated document resolves.
An earlier version of this file reported Tier B, read from routes.yaml, because it searched for a spec file and this project generates its spec rather than committing it.
